draw_instance_predictions: draw instance-level detection and segmentation predictions on video frames with persistent object colors
draw_sem_seg: draw semantic segmentation overlays on video frames with optional area threshold filtering
draw_panoptic_seg_predictions: draw panoptic segmentation predictions combining stuff and thing class masks on frames
assign_colors_to_instances: assign persistent colors to detected instances across video frames using IOU-based matching heuristics
assign_colors_by_id: assign consistent colors to tracked instances using explicit tracker IDs with color pool management
